FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer emergency callouts?

Yes. We offer emergency callouts for refrigeration and air conditioning faults so you can limit downtime and stock loss. Call us on +61 415 555 612.

What types of businesses do you work with?

We work with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, caterers, offices and storage facilities, as well as homes that need air conditioning.

Do you install air conditioning as well as refrigeration?

Yes. We supply, install and service split, multi-head and ducted air conditioning, along with cool rooms, freezers and commercial refrigeration.

How quickly can you install a new cool room?

It depends on size and site conditions, but most standard installations are completed within one to two weeks of approval.

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about our refrigeration and air conditioning services.

Do you offer emergency callouts?

Yes. We offer emergency callouts for refrigeration and air conditioning faults so you can limit downtime and stock loss. Call us on +61 415 555 612.

What types of businesses do you work with?

We work with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, caterers, offices and storage facilities, as well as homes that need air conditioning.

Do you install air conditioning as well as refrigeration?

Yes. We supply, install and service split, multi-head and ducted air conditioning, along with cool rooms, freezers and commercial refrigeration.

How quickly can you install a new cool room?

It depends on size and site conditions, but most standard installations are completed within one to two weeks of approval.

Do you install and repair heating systems?

Yes. We repair and install heating systems, including heat pumps and reverse-cycle units, for homes and businesses.

Do you provide written quotes?

Yes. Every job starts with a clear written quote so there are no surprises. Quotes are free and come with no obligation.

Which brands do you install?

We install and service leading brands including Daikin, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, Rinnai and Midea.

How do I know what size air conditioner I need?

Send us your room details or give us a call. We recommend the right size and confirm it with a free assessment.

Privacy Policy

Terms & Conditions

The terms that apply when you engage Serhan Refrigeration.

By engaging Serhan Refrigeration Pty Ltd for work, you agree to the following terms.

Quotes & Pricing

Quotes are free and valid for 30 days unless stated otherwise. Final pricing may change if site conditions differ from what was assessed.

Scheduling

We make every reasonable effort to attend on time. Emergency callouts are prioritised by urgency and availability.

Warranty

Workmanship is warranted for the period stated on your quote or invoice. Manufacturer warranties apply separately to supplied equipment.

Payment

Payment is due on completion of work unless other terms are agreed in writing, such as under a maintenance contract.
